title.zh-Hans: Light · 光 · 籁 · 如光天籁

gloss.en: Visible illumination, brightness, or something that illuminates.
gloss.zh-Hans: 可见的光、明亮状态或照明之物。

meaning.en: The brightness noun denotes visible illumination. 籁 is retained only as a separate cross-modal research candidate.
meaning.zh-Hans: brightness 名词指光；籁只保留为独立跨模态研究候选。

primary_mapping.mapping_type: Standard sense-specific mapping; research candidates separately graded

rationale.en: Standard meaning is separate from Featured selection. Structural and literary observations do not establish common origin.
rationale.zh-Hans: 标准义独立于 Featured 选择；结构和文学观察不证明同源。

summary.en: English light (brightness) ← Middle English light ← Old English lēoht/līht, inherited Germanic; deeper reconstructed *leuk- family. French lumière ← Christian Latin luminaria (plural of luminare), related to lumen. Latin lux is a related family member, NOT an intermediate ancestor of lumière. Chinese 籁 has its own instrument/sound senses.
summary.zh-Hans: English light (brightness) ← Middle English light ← Old English lēoht/līht, inherited Germanic; deeper reconstructed *leuk- family. French lumière ← Christian Latin luminaria (plural of luminare), related to lumen. Latin lux is a related family member, NOT an intermediate ancestor of lumière. Chinese 籁 has its own instrument/sound senses.

claim.en: The brightness noun is inherited through Germanic and is not a Latin borrowing. The homographic not-heavy adjective belongs to PIE *legwh- and is out of scope.
claim.zh-Hans: 表示光明的名词经日耳曼语传承，并非拉丁语借词；同形的“重量轻”形容词属于 PIE *legwh-，不在本条范围内。

claim.en: French lumière follows the luminaria/luminare/lumen line. Latin lux is a related family member, not an intermediate stage in lumière.
claim.zh-Hans: 法语 lumière 沿 luminaria／luminare／lumen 谱系发展；拉丁语 lux 是相关词族成员，不是 lumière 的中间环节。

claim.en: The Chinese word belongs to an instrument-and-sound history. No historical cognacy or borrowing with English light is established.
claim.zh-Hans: 汉语“籟／籁”属于乐器—声音历史系统；没有证据证明其与英语 light 历史同源或存在借词关系。

chain: 籁 / 籟: separate instrument and sound senses; no strict chronology asserted

summary.en: light /laɪt/ and 籁 lài show limited segmental resemblance; brightness and sound differ. French lumière /ly.mjɛʁ/ is a separate, weaker phonetic observation. No Featured winner or historical relation follows.
summary.zh-Hans: light /laɪt/ and 籁 lài show limited segmental resemblance; brightness and sound differ. French lumière /ly.mjɛʁ/ is a separate, weaker phonetic observation. No Featured winner or historical relation follows.

claim.en: The modern forms share an approximate /laɪ/ sequence, while their lexical meanings differ. This motivates a testable LIGHT ↔ SOUND/MUSIC cross-modal comparison rather than an etymological claim.
claim.zh-Hans: 两个现代读音共享近似 /laɪ/ 序列，但直接词义不同；这支持提出可检验的 LIGHT ↔ SOUND／MUSIC 跨模态比较，而不是词源主张。

summary.en: The author’s LIGHT ↔ SOUND / MUSIC association is literary motivation, not a validated cognitive law.
summary.zh-Hans: The author’s LIGHT ↔ SOUND / MUSIC association is literary motivation, not a validated cognitive law.

summary.en: Author hypotheses remain independently graded and testable; they are not historical proof.
summary.zh-Hans: 作者假说保持独立分级与可检验性，不作为历史证明。

claim.en: Test whether the modern resemblance between light /laɪt/ and 籁 lài /laɪ̯⁵¹/ strengthens a LIGHT ↔ SOUND/MUSIC association. No translation equivalence, sound law, borrowing or common origin is asserted.
claim.zh-Hans: 检验 light /laɪt/ 与“籁” lài /laɪ̯⁵¹/ 的现代近音是否会增强 LIGHT ↔ SOUND／MUSIC 联想；本假说不主张翻译等值、音变规律、借词或共同词源。

claim.en: Test whether L-initial light/brightness words occur above a language-specific baseline after etymological-family deduplication. The four motivating surface positives collapse to one PIE *leuk- family at the deepest level.
claim.zh-Hans: 在进行词源家族去重后，检验 L 起首的光／明亮词是否高于各语言基线。四个表面正例在最深层均归入同一 PIE *leuk- 词族。

claim.en: light /laɪt/ ↔ 籁 lài shares an approximate /laɪ/ sequence; lexical meanings differ.
claim.zh-Hans: light /laɪt/ ↔ 籁 lài 共享近似 /laɪ/ 音序，但直接词义不同。

limitations.en: Modern-form resemblance is not a regular sound correspondence or proof of cognacy.
limitations.zh-Hans: 现代词形近似不是规律音变，也不证明同源。
